scope: Headless dedicated browser Worker microbenchmark; source-bundled current and reconstructed previous accumulator, not a full workbook. Each sample feeds 100,000 referenced values (all numeric or repeating number/text/boolean/blank) into SUM/MIN/MAX/COUNT and verifies the result. Six alternating rounds in each fresh Worker pair. Excludes formula parsing, dependencies, IndexedDB, output/UI latency, worker/process memory, other devices and direct argument behavior.
